Which one sentence explains most accurately why spin trapping is often used to detect free radical intermediates?
Option A: spin trapping provides more structural information than direct detection by EPR
Option B: spin trapping makes it easy to quantify free radical intermediates
Option C: steady state concentration of free radical intermediates is often too low to enable direct detection by EPR
Option D: detection of spin adducts requires lower power than direct detection of radical intermediates
